description: Actions are pinned to commit SHAs. A tag is mutable, and check.yaml runs with the repo's token on every PR, so a retagged action must not land here without a commit. Renovate keeps the SHAs current.
platformAutomerge hands the merge to GitHub once the required checks are green; the main ruleset marks them required.
peercheck is the gate itself, so a new version (which can change what passes) is reviewed by hand, never automerged.

customManagers.description: The peercheck release pinned in check.yaml.

packageRules.description: Action digests and minor bumps are safe to take unattended once CI is green.
